summary: Iteration 15 - Frontend-only QA of the new wheel time picker + mini calendar date picker + animated illustrations (toggle via settings-reduce-motion). Logged in via welcome-demo-patient-button, created a TEST_MED_PICKER_1 medication with three times (8:00 AM, 2:30 PM, 9:00 PM) using field-times-add -> field-times-picker-sheet; confirmed 3 rows render correctly; opened edit on row 1 and verified sheet opened on the saved 2:30 PM (field-times-picker-preview); changed the wheel selection then pressed field-times-picker-cancel and confirmed the row remained 2:30 PM (unchanged on cancel). Verified backdrop close for both time and date sheets: pressing top of screen (outside the sheet) closes the sheet without applying changes; the X (field-times-picker-sheet-close) also closes without applying. Date picker: Hoy chip + confirm set 2026-11-25; cancel after selecting field-start_date-tomorrow kept the previous value. Reopened the saved record via /record-form?kind=medications&id=<id> and verified: name field populated, 3 times rendered (08:00/14:30/21:00 displayed as 8:00 AM/2:30 PM/9:00 PM in 12h mode), opening row 0 edit shows preview 'Horario elegido: 8:00 AM', opening field-start_date shows preview 'Miércoles, 25 de noviembre de 2026'. Backend GET /api/records/medications returns times='08:00, 14:30, 21:00' and start_date='2026-11-25' - stored in required formats. Leap year: field-start_date-header -> field-start_date-next twice (2026->2028) -> field-start_date-month-2 renders 29 day buttons (field-start_date-day-2028-02-01..29); going back one year -> Feb 2027 renders 28 day buttons - correct. Past treatment (/record-form?kind=treatments): header month/year jump field-date-year-10 (-10 yrs) + field-date-month-6 + field-date-day-2016-06-15 saved and GET /api/records/treatments returned date='2016-06-15'. Future appointment (/record-form?kind=events): field-date-next -> field-date-day-2026-12-10 and field-time wheels (hour-10, minute-15, period-AM) saved and GET /api/records/events returned date='2026-12-10' time='10:15' (24h). 12h/24h toggle: field-times-picker-format-24 hides the period wheel and exposes hour-item-23; field-times-picker-format-12 restores the period wheel. Desktop viewport (1280x800) opens the sheet as a centred card (width measured at 400px via getBoundingClientRect, left=440). 360x740 and 390x844 viewports show scrollWidth==clientWidth with the sheet open and closed. Moods: Home mood-cards remain in place (no horizontal shift, scrollWidth==clientWidth after selecting En calma / Con energia / Cansado/a). Signal flow: home-signal-compania -> signal-confirm-send -> home-signal-sent-compania indicator appears after success. Settings: /settings -> settings-reduce-motion switch toggles successfully; home continues to render with reduce_motion ON; toggled back OFF for cleanup. All TEST_ records created were deleted via DELETE /api/records/<kind>/<id>. demo@amodo.app left on patient role, time format 12h, reduce_motion OFF, Plus status unchanged. No React Native red screen, no page errors, no console errors beyond the pre-existing expo-notifications push-token warning on web.

react_native_issues.issue: Console still reports 'expo-router/unstable-native-tabs is deprecated. Use expo-router/native-tabs instead.' Not introduced in iter 15. Reference: frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx

critical_code_review_comments: src/pickers.tsx: PickerSheet correctly branches desktop (>=720px) to a centred 400px card via animationType='fade' and borderRadius=28; mobile uses animationType='slide' with bottom insets padding - verified visually and via getBoundingClientRect.

src/pickers.tsx: Wheel implements a settle() timer (140ms) to snap to the nearest value after mouse-wheel scroll on web via scrollSnapType='y mandatory' plus a JS fallback - time preview updates correctly on click of hour/minute items.

src/pickers.tsx: DateSheet computes days with new Date(ym.y, ym.m + 1, 0).getDate() which correctly handles 28/29/30/31-day months including leap years (verified Feb 2028 = 29 days, Feb 2027 = 28 days).
src/pickers.tsx: TimesField stores as a sorted, deduped comma-joined 24h string and renders via fmtTime respecting user's time_24h setting - round-trip (save -> reopen) preserves values correctly.
src/pickers.tsx:256 setFormat persists time_24h via updateMe({settings:{time_24h}}) - verified the wheel re-mounts (round counter) and period wheel appears/disappears accordingly.

success_rate.backend: not tested this iteration (unchanged per request); backend GETs used for verification succeeded (200)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of in-scope flows pass: 29 PASS, 0 FAIL across 3 sub-runs

seed_data_creation: Created and then deleted: TEST_MED_PICKER_1 (medications), Quimioterapia with date=2016-06-15 (treatments), TEST_EVT_FUT (events, date=2026-12-10 time=10:15). All three cleaned up via DELETE /api/records/<kind>/<id>. demo@amodo.app left on patient role, time format 12h, reduce_motion OFF.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth token on web is stored as a JSON-quoted string in localStorage key 'amodo_token'; to use it in fetch: JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('amodo_token')). Picker testIDs follow a predictable pattern: <field>-sheet, <field>-sheet-backdrop, <field>-sheet-close, <field>-prev, <field>-next, <field>-header, <field>-month-<1..12>, <field>-year<n>/-year-<n>, <field>-day-YYYY-MM-DD, <field>-today, <field>-tomorrow, <field>-clear, <field>-confirm, <field>-cancel, <field>-preview for dates; and <field>-hour-item-<v>, <field>-minute-item-<v>, <field>-period-item-<AM|PM>, <field>-hour-up/-down, <field>-format-12/-format-24, <field>-confirm, <field>-cancel, <field>-preview for times. Clicking the backdrop testID directly sometimes doesn't fire onPress through react-native-web; use page.mouse.click(x, y_above_sheet) to hit the backdrop area reliably. Treatments uses field-date (not field-start_date); medications uses field-start_date and field-end_date. Events uses field-title (not field-name). All time values are stored as HH:MM (24h) strings and dates as YYYY-MM-DD strings regardless of display format.
rca_of_issue: n/a - no regressions found. The new pickers (DateSheet, TimeSheet, TimesField) work end-to-end: wheel snap, month/year jump via header, leap year day counts, 12h/24h toggle with persistence, cancel/backdrop/X all properly abort changes, edit opens on saved value, backend round-trip preserves required formats.
